_comment: The co-signer's independent copy of what it will talk to. Read by
cosigner/attest.py; not env-supplied, unlike EXPECTED_COMPOSE_HASH in
deploy/phala/docker-compose.yml, which the enclave hands to itself and
which is therefore advisory. This file is the point of the second box:
the enclave cannot edit it.
mode: 'required' verifies the RA-TLS quote on every unseen client
certificate. 'dev-insecure' skips verification and is refused unless
measurements is empty and TEE_REQUIRED is unset -- see attest.mode().
Every row it writes to the audit log carries attested=0, so the log shows
exactly which period ran unverified.
dev_insecure_expires: the day 'dev-insecure' stops being accepted, after
which the co-signer refuses to start. Required whenever the mode is set,
because nothing else in the system notices that verification is off: the
enclave's own check (backend/custody/client.py) only fires under
TEE_REQUIRED, and until the Phala cutover nothing sets it. Move the date
and you have decided to, rather than discovered a year later that you had.
measurements: one entry per authorized image. A null field is an explicit
operator statement that the field is not pinned; mr_td must always be.
Populate before deploying a new compose hash, not after: an image absent
from here cannot unwrap, and no mail moves (plan §2).
binding: how report_data ties the quote to the TLS certificate.
'pem-sha256' matches backend/tee/tee_boot._report_data_for_cert.
Confirm against a live dstack RA-TLS certificate at the Phala cutover.
